newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee soft on demand for dollars.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee soft on demand for dollars.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed lower on Thursday on commercial demand for dollars, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.78, after opening at 56.72 after a two-day Christmas break, they said.
"There was some import covering. But the market is so thin that the slightest activity makes a big difference," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 13 percent, with the market well offered, he said.
